heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, then a few clouds through NY into the Green Mountains, and east from the Quebec border north. Lows in the 30s, except low to mid 40s in the Champlain Valley west and north. Winds south near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west, and becoming light and variable east.

heading: Monday
text: Variable clouds and sun from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north. A few morning clouds south, then mostly sunny. Highs in the 60s, a few upper 50s northeast. Winds light, less than 10 mph east, and south to southwest near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Monday Night
text: Becoming mostly cloudy north. Thickening high clouds south. Lows in the 40s. Winds light and variable east, and southwest near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly cloudy from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north, with a rising chance of showers midday and afternoon through Quebec, south into the Adirondacks and northern Greens. Clouds and some filtered sun south. Continued warm. Highs in the 60s, closer to 60 northeast. Light winds becoming south to southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west.
